breaks.why: The reader gets no steps between trying one line on customers and being confident, so they must guess how he got there.

breaks.quote: for years he sent his assistant to present for him, even in his own boardroom
breaks.why: A cafe owner with a boardroom, and no reason given for sending an assistant, leaves the reader guessing the background.

breaks.quote: In late October, he came to me with a deadline: the December meeting, in his own voice.
breaks.why: It does not say what made him come now or what his own voice means, so a leap is left unserved.
